Shung Ye Museum of Formosan Aborigines
This museum houses exhibitions of Aboriginal culture and lifestyle. An English audio guide is available.

The theme of the park is the aboriginal culture. There are sixteen stone-slab sculptures stand in the entrance of the park, depicting the people of Taiwan's sixteen tribes in their traditional costumes.
